title: Hazards against incidents, week by week
subtitle: The measure the redesign puts on the manager's screen, because total report volume could not tell a safe restaurant from a silent one.
note: A restaurant finding hazards before anyone is hurt looks nothing like one that reports only after an injury. The ratio separates them; the total does not.
source: The measure proposed in the December 2025 findings report, drawn on one restaurant's period.
